race.description: Powered By Next Level Racing Mdn Hcp
race.comment: THE GREY ONE (6) has clear upside after charging home for second on debut at this track despite racing wide throughout, and that race experience can take him forward. GRANDSTANDER (11) is the immediate danger after missing by a nose at Gatton and has the benefit of race fitness, weight relief and another soft-ground placing two back. WORTHY STUNNAH (1) is also in the mix third-up after consecutive placings, with his Ipswich third better than the margin suggests after being held up passing the 250m. LAWES ROAD (4) stuck on gamely into a midfield finish on debut at Doomben. Is sure to have come on from that and has plenty of upside.
